title.zh: Flapping Airplanes融资10亿美元：创始人孵化过Cursor，想从GPU底层改写AI训练
title.en: Flapping Airplanes融资10亿美元：创始人孵化过Cursor，想从GPU底层改写AI训练

current_state.zh: AI research lab Flapping Airplanes, founded roughly a year ago by Prod incubator co-founder and ThunderKittens/Megakernel author Ben Spector, raised a $1B Series A led by Index Ventures and Lux Capital at a $6B valuation, to pursue a GPU-kernel-level rewrite of AI training and inference that has already shown large efficiency gains over vLLM and SGLang.
